abs_diff_image — 2D nary op

• Data kinds: image × image → image

• Call: this op takes 2 inputs, so fullseye.apply cannot run it (that is the one-image model). g = fullseye.FullseyeGraph(); g.add("out", "abs_diff_image", ["$in1", "$in2"], a=0.5, b=0.5); g.run({"$in1": img1, "$in2": img2}, terminal="out") (names starting with $ are the inputs you pass in)

• HALCON equivalent: abs_diff_image (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

2 枚の画像の差の絶対値。HALCON の `abs_diff_image に相当。out = clip(|I1 - I2| * (0.5 + 1.5a), 0, 1)。変化検出の基本形で、符号を捨てる代わりに明暗どちらの変化も拾う。b` は未使用。
